# OpenXR headers

Khronos OpenXR headers vendored from Thru3D-Media-Player `959abc2a83ec4887ae2793d39e05daa2955414bd` (`third_party/openxr/include/openxr`), preserving their original notices and Apache-2.0 OR MIT license. Used only for the video compositor bridge; Godot owns the loader, instance, session and frame submission.
